question: Where should the image-guardians joined with the images be deposited?
premises: They are joined with the images.
The place of deposition is the edge of the mountain.
inference: The image-guardians joined with the images should be deposited at the edge of the mountain.
uncertainties: parvata may refer to the sesame-mountain heap
plain_english: One should deposit the image-guardians, together with the images, at the edge of the mountain.
